# signoz_service_account (Resource)

Manages a SigNoz service account (`/api/v1/service_accounts`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Service account display name. Used for data source lookup when `id` is not set.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when the object was created. Read-only.
- `email` (String) Email address assigned by SigNoz for the service account. Read-only.
- `id` (String) SigNoz-assigned UUID. Read-only.
- `org_id` (String) Organization UUID. Read-only.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when the object was last updated. Read-only.
